description: This file defines a Kivy UI widget class 'Camera' for capturing and displaying video from a camera, including properties for camera index, resolution, and playback control, with methods to handle camera initialization and texture updates.

classes.name: Camera
classes.description: A widget for capturing and displaying camera video, with properties to control camera index, resolution, and playback state.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Camera widget, binds property change handlers, and sets default camera index.

methods.name: on_tex
methods.description: Updates the widget's texture with the camera's current texture and requests a canvas update.

methods.name: _on_index
methods.description: Handles camera initialization based on the current index and resolution, and starts the camera if 'play' is True.

methods.name: on_play
methods.description: Starts or stops the camera based on the 'play' property value.
